sources.quote: Unlocking social and financial capital for impact-creating startups solving the world’s biggest problems. Real impact takes root when startups and ecosystems grow together. We support entrepreneurs through accelerator programs and resources across our thematic areas: Climate Innovation & Adaptation, Economic Mobility, and Equitable Access to Essential Services. Learn more about our startup programs. We strengthen ecosystems by partnering with locally-led ESOs to co-deliver programs for entrepreneurs. We also equip ESOs with tools, methodologies, and curriculum. Learn more about our ESO programs. We unlock capital by structuring, managing, and deploying funds through a variety of financing structures (such as equity, debt, and revenue-share) to connect impact-creating startups with the right type of capital for them. Learn more about our impact investing work. We reimagine the entrepreneurship support system and build tools everyone can use . Use our tools today.
